hook: Swirling fluid in a cylinder with total slip stays smooth forever if its initial swirl is small enough.
summary: The paper proves that axisymmetric Navier-Stokes solutions in a finite cylinder with zero-friction slip stay smooth for all time. This holds when the initial swirl has zero mean and a scale-invariant smallness condition holds. The proof uses a trace identity and an L^4 bound that replaces the lost maximum principle. The smallness condition limits the result, and the general large-data question stays open.
title: Global regularity of axisymmetric Navier--Stokes equations under total slip and critical smallness
